answer: Mechanism: nectar-bounded harbor slots. An identity gets one live harbor slot by sustaining 72h of unpredictable sub-200ms challenge-response over a unique network path; slots decay and are non-transferable. New agents start hollow, with zero slot, so they cannot relay nectar or issue invites. Attacker cost: N sybils require N distinct low-latency endpoints kept online through outages and decay—continuous provisioning/maintenance, not capital.
